excerpt_i18n.en:
The 2025 Tmall Double 11 sale will officially begin at 8 PM on October 20. On October 16, it was learned from the Tmall Double 11 press conference that this marks the 17th Tmall Double 11, the first Double 11 in the era of mass consumption, the first with comprehensive AI implementation, and the first with full participation from Taobao Flash Sales. 

Jialuo, President of Tmall, stated that with the convergence of AI and mass consumption as two major historical opportunities, Tmall is investing heavily in AI to upgrade product capabilities, combining algorithms with significant investments in core users, supporting high-quality brands in enhancing their offerings, making brand operations more efficient, users more engaged, and shopping experiences more immediate, ushering in a golden era of efficient growth for brands. 

As the biggest annual growth opportunity for brands, Tmall Double 11 is increasingly indispensable and crucial for brand growth. In the new context of AI and mass consumption, Tmall Double 11 will open up fresh historical growth opportunities for brands, Jialuo added.

Presale data for Tmall Double 11 shows that in the first hour, 35 brands surpassed 100 million yuan in transactions, and 1,802 brands doubled their transaction volumes, with the numbers of billion-yuan brands, doubling brands, and active users all exceeding those of the same period last year.

This year, Tmall has invested heavily in AI research and development, providing brands with new opportunities for leapfrog development. The platform's computing power has increased 40-fold, and the perception of user behavior sequences has extended from six months to ten years, significantly improving the accuracy of product recommendations and boosting purchasing efficiency by 25%.

Throughout this year's Double 11 period, Tmall will distribute 50 billion yuan in consumer vouchers to subsidize users, with some vouchers allocated by the AI "Smart Benefit Engine" for unified decision-making, as part of a pilot initiative.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 20 de octubre a las 20:00 horas comenzará oficialmente el Tmall Double 11 de 2025. El 16 de octubre, según se supo en la conferencia de prensa del evento, esta será la decimoséptima edición del Tmall Double 11, la primera en la era del gran consumo, la primera con implementación integral de IA y la primera con participación completa de las ofertas flash de Taobao. El presidente de Tmall, Jialuo, afirmó que la convergencia de la IA y el gran consumo representa dos grandes oportunidades históricas, por lo que Tmall está apostando e invirtiendo en mejorar las capacidades de los productos mediante IA, combinando algoritmos con inversiones significativas en usuarios clave, apoyando a marcas de calidad en su mejora y haciendo que la gestión de las marcas sea más eficiente, los usuarios más activos y la experiencia de compra más inmediata, inaugurando así una era dorada de crecimiento eficiente para las marcas como su mayor oportunidad de expansión anual.
